job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant / Senior Recruitment Consultant

Technology Recruitment

Cardiff HQ | Hybrid (3 days in office) £30,000 - £50,000 DOE + uncapped commission

We're growing the Technology team at Yolk and looking for someone who wants more than just another recruitment job.

This is an opportunity to join an established team with a strong reputation across Technology, Data, Cloud, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and Software Engineering. You'll have the freedom to build your own market, develop client relationships, and create a desk that genuinely feels like your own.

Whether your background is primarily permanent recruitment or contract, we're open-minded. We'll play to your strengths while helping you broaden your skillset if that's something you're interested in.

Equally, if you've built a successful career in sales, account management or business development and fancy applying those skills in recruitment, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

  • Running a 360 recruitment desk from business development through to placement
  • Building long-term relationships with hiring managers and candidates
  • Developing your own specialist market within technology
  • Winning new business and growing existing accounts
  • Managing your own activity, pipeline and desk performance
  • Contributing to a collaborative team environment where people share ideas and support each other

What we're looking for

  • Recruitment experience, or a strong background in sales, account management or business development
  • Someone who enjoys building relationships and creating opportunities
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of what drives results
  • Comfortable picking up the phone and having conversations others avoid
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn

Technology recruitment experience is helpful but by no means essential.

What you'll get

  • Uncapped commission from day one
  • A genuine opportunity to build and own your market
  • Access to established clients, tools, marketing support and leadership backing
  • Clear progression opportunities as you grow
  • Quarterly incentives and team socials
  • Birthday day off
  • Extended Christmas shutdown
  • Employee wellbeing and benefits package
  • Up to £1,500 referral bonus

Why Yolk?

We're ambitious, but we're not interested in KPI theatre.

We care about activity, standards and results, but we trust people to manage their own desks. You'll be given support when you need it, freedom when you've earned it, and the opportunity to build something meaningful rather than simply maintain somebody else's desk.

If you're looking for a business where you can make an impact, earn well, and enjoy what you do, let's have a conversation.

For a confidential chat, contact Lewis Allen or apply with your CV.
